value.rationale: This natural smallest nontrivial exterior algebra has both nonzero wedge multiplication and nontrivial families of retracts. The complete q-uniform commuting graph and maximal Boolean retraction families distinguish compatible algebra splittings from rank-one linear idempotence; the exact probability determines a natural asymptotic semigroup invariant. Complete natural classification across fields is meaningful despite small generator rank.
